mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect clear skies with a temperature of 63 degrees at Badger Ridge Middle School, under the glow of a Waning Gibbous moon.

The Verona Police Department reminds residents that their Records Section handles all public records requests and crash reports. You can now access motor vehicle crash forms online through crashdocs dot org, and the department works to fulfill all requests within 10 business days.
There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus the Farmers Market downtown.
In a noteworthy call from the past week, a 29-year-old Madison woman was arrested for an O W I offence on July 25.

Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Covered Strawberry. While the store is currently closed, it opens at 10 AM, and you can also visit the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today between 11 AM and 2 PM.
